 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Simplipal National Park is located in the state of **Odisha, India**.
 
• It is situated in the **Mayurbhanj district** of northern Odisha.
 
• Simplipal National Park covers an area of **2,750 square kilometers**.
 
• The park was designated a **tiger reserve in 1973** and a **biosphere reserve in 1994**.
 
• It is renowned for its **rich biodiversity** and diverse wildlife, including tigers, elephants, and numerous species of birds and reptiles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Flora and Fauna**:

 
 
• Simplipal National Park is home to over **1,076 species of plants** from 102 families.
 
• The park supports diverse fauna, including **42 species of mammals**, 242 species of birds, and 30 species of reptiles.
 
 
 
• **Topography**:
 
 
• The park features a mix of **hills, valleys, and dense forests**.
 
• It is part of the **Eastern Ghats** mountain range.
 
 
 
• **Waterfalls**:
 
 
• Simplipal is known for its **numerous waterfalls**, including the **Barehipani** and **Joranda** falls.
 
• Barehipani Falls is one of the highest waterfalls in India with a height of **399 meters**.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Efforts**:
 
 
• Efforts are ongoing to conserve the **tiger population** and other endangered species within the park.
 
• Initiatives include **anti-poaching measures** and habitat restoration projects.
